sam: Quick heads-up: short rolling maintenance in az-east1 to apply NIC microcode and small kernel fix. Window: 2026-06-02 01:00-04:00 UTC. Targets 4 cohorts.
jess: cohort size? effect on latency?
sam: cohorts = 10 racks (~9% region each). Per-cohort ~25m. Expect brief p95 spikes, no hard evictions planned.
mohit: can we prewarm kvcache and mirror small traffic?
sam: yes - preheat 10m before each cohort. Run on ops bastion: 
```
ops@bastion$ kvcache-seed --region az-east1 --cohort 1 --shards 10 --concurrency 6
```
oncall-bot: Maintenance event scheduled https://status.redwood/maintenance/az-east1-1813334444
jess: rollback?
sam: if p95>300ms or errors >0.8% for 3min -> stop further cohorts, keep cohort cordoned, fail traffic to us-west fallback. Notify customers.
mohit: noting cost center infra-maint for any cross-region egress.
sam: I'll post runbook & playbook in #eng-sre and enable high-res tracing for the window. Thanks.
